latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the web application fuzzing automation skill.

- Automates customized attacks against web apps for identifier enumeration, data harvesting, and fuzzing using parameterized payloads.
- Supports detection via HTTP status code, response length, time, headers, and custom grep expressions.
- Details payloads for SQLi, XSS, OS command injection, path traversal, script injection, and RFI.
- Guides Burp Intruder attack type selection and advanced session-handling (cookie jar, macros, token management).
- Addresses automation blockers like anti-CSRF tokens, session expiry, and CAPTCHA.
- Includes triage instructions for sorting and analyzing automated results.
- Designed for authorized penetration testers and appsec professionals with Burp Suite Pro or equivalents.
